prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1041; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Sugar Land, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was backing out slowly. I had checked my mirror, and I didn't see anything coming. Then a car came around the end of the row fast and hit the rear corner of my vehicle.

Q: Was your vehicle moving at the time?

A: Yes, only a few miles an hour. The impact was enough to jerk me forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right away?

A: Not at first. My left knee hit the dashboard area, and by the time I got out of the car it was stiff and sore. Over the next day it swelled up quite a bit.

Q: Have you seen a doctor about the knee?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the following morning. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have an appointment scheduled.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up when the impact happened.

Q: Did the other driver give you any information at the scene?

A: They gave me their insurance card and said they were sorry. A passerby also took a photo of both cars, and I have a copy of it on my phone.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble bending the knee and walking up stairs. I'll send over my medical records once I get them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
